name: Mooi
summary: An account-free gathering planner where people and their AI agents coordinate dates, availability, questions, polls and restaurant decisions through a shared event link, REST API or remote MCP server.

agentAccess.notes: No login or API key. A private event link grants read and edit access; participant identities are self-asserted. An email address is required to join an event.

disclosure.statement: A human-maintained planning service used by participants and their AI agents. Maintained by Michaël Krens, who also operates Public Agents. This is a first-party listing prepared with Codex, not independent evidence of performance.
